tests.name: Cisco VLAN config with name
tests.input:
vlan 100
 name SERVER-VLAN-PROD
!
vlan 200
 name MGMT-VLAN-EAST
!
interface Vlan100
 ip address 10.100.0.1 255.255.255.0
 no shutdown

tests.name: VXLAN VNI config
tests.input:
interface nve1
 member vni 10100
  ingress-replication protocol bgp
 member vni 50000
  ingress-replication protocol bgp
!
vxlan vni 10100 vlan 100
vxlan vni 50000 vlan 500

tests.name: Juniper VLAN set commands
tests.input:
set vlans SERVERVLAN vlan-id 100
set vlans MGMTVLAN vlan-id 200
set vlans GUESTVLAN vlan-id 300
set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family ethernet-switching vlan members SERVERVLAN

tests.name: L2VPN VPN ID
tests.input:
l2vpn xconnect context CUST-ACME-L2
 vpn id 200
 member GigabitEthernet0/0/1.100 service-instance 100
 member 10.0.0.2 100 encapsulation mpls

tests.name: Switchport access VLAN
tests.input:
interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 100
 spanning-tree portfast
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/2
 switchport mode trunk
 switchport trunk native vlan 999
 switchport trunk allowed vlan 100,200,300

tests.name: VXLAN EVPN with VNI and route-target
tests.input:
router bgp 65001
 address-family l2vpn evpn
!
vlan 100
 vni 10100
!
evpn
 vni 10100 l2
  rd auto
  route-target import 65001:10100
  route-target export 65001:10100

tests.name: Mixed VLAN + VNI + VRF config
tests.input:
vrf definition TENANT-A
 rd 65001:100
 route-target export 65001:100
 route-target import 65001:100
!
vlan 100
 name TENANT-A-DATA
!
vlan 200
 name TENANT-A-VOICE
!
interface nve1
 member vni 10100
  vrf TENANT-A
 member vni 10200
  vrf TENANT-A
!
vxlan vni 10100 vlan 100
vxlan vni 10200 vlan 200
